correctness.problem: Regex covers `no server running` (socket file exists, server exited) but not the missing-socket shape. Verified on this box, tmux 3.7c: `tmux -L <absent> kill-pane -t %1` -> `error connecting to <path> (No such file or directory)` exit 1. The documented upgrade runbook (kill default-server session, start new daemon) and any reboot clearing TMUX_TMPDIR hit this shape at boot: reconnectWorkers -> markWorkerDead -> retireWorkerLocator -> stopProcess throws StopFailed before `delete current.locator` (:755-757); dead workers keep their locators and runningWorkerCount slots until an architect respawns that role after ensureController created the server.
correctness.fix: Treat a connect failure to the daemon's own socket as pane-gone (extend the regex with `error connecting to .*No such file or directory`, or handle it in tmux.killPane); update the stopProcess doc comment and AGENTS.md:109; add a processes.test.ts case with that stderr asserting the locator is cleared.

correctness.problem: launchingSecrets is a Set and the file is written before the per-issue serialize lane. Two overlapping spawnRoot generations for one root (documented :2075-2098, exercised by processes.test.ts:1064) share the token: gen 2's add is a no-op, gen 1's finally deletes it while gen 2's body is still queued; gen 1 takes the stale-generation branch without storing a locator and spawnRoot's persist prunes legion-<project>-<root>-architect while gen 2's pane launch is in flight. Reproduced by the deep-review pass by extending the :1064 test to await gen 2's write before releasing gen 1 (tree active, locator %2, secrets/ empty). Impact: gen 2's pane boots to a missing file, requiredSecret throws, registration deadline retires it, launchFailures++.
correctness.fix: Refcount (Map<string, number>) in withPaneSecret/liveSecretFiles; move writeSecretFile inside serialize(issueLaunchQueue, ...) in launchShimmedProcess; extend the :1064 test to assert the architect's secret file survives.

rulings.C2_writePlacement: ACCEPTED as implemented (write before the per-issue serialize lane, under the owner's refcount hold). /process/started checks tree generation (409) before the boot token and the token record is generation-bound (api/routes/process.ts:14,22), so a stale pane reading the newer token cannot assume its identity; the refcount alone closes the prune race; in-lane placement changes nothing for the reverse-order case; the deterministic regression test depends on observing gen 2's write before gen 1 settles. Deep-review found no interleaving the refcount misses that in-lane placement would fix.
rulings.reverseOrderGenerations: OUT OF SCOPE, does not block. Consequence of the accepted role-token file naming; same-tree/same-role daemon-launched panes only; self-heals via registration deadline (403 at /process/started -> retire -> launchFailures++ -> resurrect). Unreachable in the documented park-then-re-admit ordering. Same class: a failed newer generation rolls tree.generation back (spawnRoot:1318) while the still-current older pane may have read the failed generation's token. Architect's call on a stale-at-lane-entry guard follow-up.
